summary: Fintech products for venues and merchants: a box-office web panel, a customer wallet app, a merchant POS terminal and the company design system, shipped to web, iOS and Android.
highlights: Built the Box Office web panel from its first commit and remain its main contributor: product and ticket sales, wallet top-ups, customer management and a reporting dashboard used daily by venue staff.
Built the JoyPort customer wallet app nearly single-handedly: phone + OTP sign-in, onboarding, QR scan and pay, profile and account screens, and a WebView bridge to the wallet-as-a-service web app.

Main contributor to the company's React component library (smart table, select, virtual keyboard, modal, sidebar, date-time field) and contributor to SuperUI, the cross-platform React / React Native library.
Added the PAX POS device mode with NFC card payments and transaction filtering to the Merchant Terminal app.
Built a customer-facing ticket booking site, shipped wallet, deposit and payment features in the WaaS web app, and migrated two marketing sites to static Next.js builds.
